title: India’s ‘Cockroach’ Leaders Released as Small Protests Go On in Delhi
summary_full: The leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party, an Indian youth movement, had been detained by the police on Saturday before they could lead protests over voting rights.
summary_public: The leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party, an Indian youth movement, had been detained by the police on Saturday before they could lead protests over voting rights.
